author_or_institution: Thomas W. Lippman / The Washington Post
title: As Burns Takes Bow at State, a Fan Sox It to Him
book_use: Contemporaneous State Department farewell account documenting a presidential autographed Red Sox cap and an AP reporter's Red Sox alarm-clock gift; strong evidence that Burns's fandom was publicly legible within his professional press/White House environment before Greece, without establishing private reaction or diplomatic effect
